name: theme-readme
description: Box theming: copies a README attachment ($README_FILENAME) to every real user's Desktop, and optionally writes Forensics-Questions.txt from $FORENSICS_TEXT (cosmetic flavor text -- never wired into scoring). Both vars independently optional. Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py.
script:
#!/bin/sh
# theme-readme -- copies the README attachment ($README_FILENAME) to every real user's
# Desktop (+ /etc/skel for future users), and optionally writes Forensics-Questions.txt
# from $FORENSICS_TEXT (pre-formatted Q&A text with blank answer lines; cosmetic flavor
# text only, never wired into scoring). Both vars are independently optional.
set -e

# Resolve a user's XDG Desktop dir without sourcing anything as root: extract
# XDG_DESKTOP_DIR from user-dirs.dirs by hand and only accept a $HOME-relative or
# absolute value, falling back to $home/Desktop.
nakon_desktop_dir() {
    home="$1"
    dirs_file="$home/.config/user-dirs.dirs"
    desktop=""
    if [ -f "$dirs_file" ]; then
        raw=$(grep '^XDG_DESKTOP_DIR=' "$dirs_file" | head -n1 | cut -d'"' -f2)
        case "$raw" in
            \$HOME/*) desktop="$home/${raw#\$HOME/}" ;;
            /*) desktop="$raw" ;;
        esac
    fi
    [ -n "$desktop" ] || desktop="$home/Desktop"
    echo "$desktop"
}

here="$(pwd)"

apply_for() {
    home="$1"
    desktop="$(nakon_desktop_dir "$home")"
    mkdir -p "$desktop"
    if [ -n "$README_FILENAME" ] && [ -f "$here/$README_FILENAME" ]; then
        cp "$here/$README_FILENAME" "$desktop/"
    fi
    if [ -n "$FORENSICS_TEXT" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$FORENSICS_TEXT" > "$desktop/Forensics-Questions.txt"
    fi
}

awk -F: '($3>=1000 && $3<60000 && $7 !~ /(nologin|false)$/) {print $1":"$6}' /etc/passwd |
while IFS=: read -r nakon_u nakon_h; do
    [ -d "$nakon_h" ] || continue
    apply_for "$nakon_h"
    chown -R "$nakon_u":"$nakon_u" "$(nakon_desktop_dir "$nakon_h")" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# Future users: seed /etc/skel/Desktop the same way (root:root -- useradd -m fixes it up).
apply_for /etc/skel

exit 0
